subject: Post-demo starter grant request & reconciliation
messages:
From: Sarah Owens <sarah.owens@cloudsprint.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo follow-up — starter credits for pilot

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — the team at CloudSprint was impressed by the latency profile and the rollout controls. We'd like to run a 60-day pilot for our data-integration product and are hoping Redwood can provide starter credits to help scope internal validation.

Request: 30,000 token-equivalent starter credits applied to account CloudSprint (deal RWF-4572) and a potential 14-day extension window after the 60 days if we hit the ingestion milestone. We usually need a simple reconciliation spreadsheet so our finance team can map credits to test runs. I attached a short pilot scope and target success metrics.

Would you be able to confirm feasibility and any approval path / PO thresholds? If there's a standard pilot agreement or short addendum we can sign, please point me at it.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sarah Owens
Head of Product Partnerships
CloudSprint
Attachment: pilot_scope_v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Owens <sarah.owens@cloudsprint.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:02:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — starter credits for pilot

Laura / Markus — looping you in on a post-demo request from CloudSprint. Quick summary:

- External asks: 30k starter credits for a 60-day pilot + optional 14-day extension.
- They want a reconciliation spreadsheet for their finance team (see attached).
- Deal: RWF-4572 (early-stage, high potential: integration with dedicated inference nodes).

Proposal from my side:
- Approve a 30,000 token-equivalent starter credit grant charged to SDR promo pool (we can mark as non-billable for 90 days).
- Add a conditional 14-day extension that requires a short milestone check (ingestion >= 50k events).
- Supply CloudSprint with starter_credit_matrix.csv for their finance mapping and request they sign the pilot addendum (DocuSign link to follow).

Markus — can you confirm there are no technical constraints on provisioning a reserved grant on their account (allowlist, dedicated pool routing) and estimate time to provision?

Laura — need your approval on using promo pool for this scale and confirm we can record as a marketing/sales pilot expense vs. a credits write-off. If you approve, I'll send the DocuSign and the official starter credit file to Sarah.

If helpful I can also schedule a 20–30m call with CloudSprint's procurement to align PO timing.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: starter_credit_matrix.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Owens <sarah.owens@cloudsprint.com>, procure@cloudsprint.com
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — starter credits for pilot

Ben — thanks for the summary. Approved.

- Finance ok to pull from the SDR/partner promo pool for a one-time 30,000 starter grant tied to RWF-4572. Please tag expense as "pilot_promo_2026Q2" so we can reconcile in July close.
- Conditional 14-day extension is acceptable; include the milestone checklist in the pilot addendum (simple checkbox for ingestion >= 50k).

Markus — please proceed with provisioning and confirm the allowlist details. Aim to have credits visible to their account within 48 hours after DocuSign completion. Ben — go ahead and send the DocuSign link and cc finance (finance@redwood.ai) on the signature.

Sarah — welcome aboard. I'll be monitoring metrics but leave the operational handoff to Ben and Markus. If procurement needs a short amendment, our legal team can fast-track a one-page addendum.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Growth Ops
Redwood Inference
